_comment: What a pattern's tokens play, as stroke ids in a kit.
strokes: the words a mrid: line is written in, looked up lowercased. They
follow the usual stroke names: a stroke played with another is the two
joined by +, quoted in the pattern ("thom+dhin", "tha+num"), and so is a
name with a space ("a cha"). A pair listed here plays its entry, a stroke
recorded as one; any other pair plays each part at once, a little softer
(PAIR_GAIN in scripts/patterns.mjs), and must be on both heads. Solkattu and strokes aren't one to one, so a
mrid: line names strokes unambiguously and this table alone decides what
letters: what a sol: line's realization is written in (realize/*.json),
one letter per stroke, od and on for thom with din and with nam.
A stroke this kit has no take for plays a stand-in, {stroke, gain, standIn},
which the compiled pattern marks; when it's recorded, only its line here
changes. The left-hand tha plays thom: tha alone is thom, and tha with a
right-hand stroke is thom with it (#80).
An unknown token or letter is a build error, not a silence.

tha.standIn: the left-hand tha, not recorded yet (#80)

tha+num.standIn: the left-hand tha, not recorded yet (#80)

tha+dhin.standIn: the left-hand tha, not recorded yet (#80)

p.standIn: the left-hand tha, not recorded yet (#80)

l.standIn: mi, a light ki with the middle finger
